hypotheses: H1: C2 (RV+funding+premium+OI) beats B1 (RV-only) on 24h forward realized variance QLIKE OOS
H2: Funding-conditioned QLIKE differs by funding tercile (train thresholds)
H3: Funding tercile predicts high forward liquidation intensity (Brier skill vs climatology)

targets.primary: next-24h forward realized variance of mark-price returns (QLIKE)
targets.liquidation_risk: binary: forward liq notional > train median per market-hour

features.standardization: train-only mean/std; zero-variance columns set to 1.0

estimation: OLS on log(fwd_RV24h + 1e-12); Duan smearing factor on train
inference: per-coin day-block bootstrap (N=2000, seed=20261122); Diebold-Mariano with day-block variance

decision_gates.go_rule: rel QLIKE C2-vs-B1 <= -2.0% AND bootstrap CI95 upper bound < 0

null_policy: NOT_SUPPORTED if gate not met; no threshold-shopping after outcomes
software: stdlib + pyarrow only; numpy/pandas/scipy not used
